name: IC 1959 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 1959, a Magellanic barred spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ic1959-hubble
story: A small barred spiral of the Magellanic kind, keeping to itself with no close neighbors. Hubble measured its distance from the brightness of its brightest red giant stars.

claims.text: IC 1959 is a Magellanic barred spiral galaxy
IC 1959 is also known as HIPASS J0333-50
IC 1959 has no close neighbors: its nearest neighbor, NGC 1311, is more than 1 Mpc away
Its distance was measured from the tip of the red giant branch by Tully et al. 2006
Tully et al. 2006 used Hubble's ACS to measure distances from the brightest red giant branch stars
